description: (needs account token) Show when each domain of a site renews, at what price, and whether auto-renew is on. To stop a renewal pass autorenew=false and confirm=true, only after the human said yes. Turning auto-renew on commits a charge, so that stays the human's click in the dashboard. Never pays. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

autorenew.description: Optional: false stops the yearly renewal (needs confirm=true). Omit to only read.

confirm.description: true ONLY after the human explicitly said yes to stopping the renewal.

domain.description: Optional: which domain, when changing auto-renew. Default: the site's main domain.

site.description: The address of a site on this account (from list_sites).

name: domain_renewal
